title: Code and certificates for “Query Bounds and Explicit Quantum Circuits for Periodic Weighted Decisions”
description: Source code, exact mathematical certificates, compiled gate-sequence records and fully specified generators, logical-resource tables, pinned dependencies and reproduction instructions supporting the associated manuscript. Separate entry points verify finite classical bounds, conditional normalization sensitivity and compiled-circuit resource calculations. The archive distinguishes label-query complexity from public logical costs; it does not implement the opaque label oracle or establish hardware runtime advantage.
